title: Diagnostic safety and equipment familiarization
learningObjective: Demonstrate tool selection, isolation and safe measurement setup in a simulated bay.

equipment.label: Digital multimeter (simulated)
equipment.notes: Data-driven asset; displays only supplied measurements.

equipment.label: Scan tool panel (simulated)
equipment.notes: Renders provider-supplied codes and data only.

equipment.label: Oscilloscope (simulated)
equipment.notes: Text description is authoritative; canvas is supplementary.

points: Confirm the simulated vehicle is in a safe state before any measurement.
Treat every supplied voltage as live and select the correct meter function first.
Report an unsafe or ambiguous step instead of proceeding with the exercise.
safetyBriefing.boundaries: This is a simulated training bay. No physical vehicle, tool, or high-voltage procedure is performed, and no reading implies a real vehicle condition.

instructorDemonstration.summary: Demonstrate meter function selection, lead placement, and a scan-tool session before students begin.
steps: Select the DC voltage function and show the display before connection.
Connect the negative lead to the simulated ground point, then the positive lead.
Show the scan-tool panel with no data supplied and explain the empty state.

scenario.symptom: Simulated training bay: the instruments are connected but no measurements have been supplied yet.
scenario.systemContext: Familiarization only. Students practice selecting the correct instrument and function before any fault is introduced.

measurements.label: Illustrative supply voltage (training value)
measurements.limitations: Illustrative training value. Not a measurement of any vehicle and not an OEM specification.

descriptors: No sampled trace is supplied for this lab.
Students describe what a steady DC level would look like in text.
waveformEvidence.notes: Qualitative descriptors only; no fictional waveform is plotted.

scenario.uncertainty: Students must state which values are illustrative training inputs rather than verified measurements.

competingHypotheses.statement: The instruments are working and simply have no supplied data yet.
evidenceFor: The scan tool reports an explicit empty state.

competingHypotheses.statement: A connection fault prevents any measurement from being supplied.
evidenceFor: No reading appears after the meter is connected.
evidenceAgainst: The supplied illustrative voltage does display once requested.

testSelectionOptions.label: Check the meter function before connecting the leads
testSelectionOptions.justificationPrompt: Explain why function selection precedes connection.
testSelectionOptions.expectedObservation: The display shows the selected function with no value until data is supplied.

testSelectionOptions.label: Request a scan-tool session and read the empty state
testSelectionOptions.justificationPrompt: Explain what the empty state does and does not prove.
testSelectionOptions.expectedObservation: The panel states that nothing has been supplied.

prompts: Which instrument and function did you select first, and why?
What did the instruments show before any data was supplied?
Which values in this lab are illustrative training inputs?
What would you report to an instructor before continuing?

steps: Re-select the instrument function and re-request the supplied reading.
expectedEvidence: A repeated reading with the same conditions and provenance label.

accessibility.keyboardPath: Tab through the instrument controls, then use Enter or Space to request a reading.
textAlternatives: Every reading is shown as text with its unit and provenance.
notes: Motion is decorative and disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

technicalReviewChecklist.statement: Simulated-only scope is stated and no physical procedure is implied.
Every reading carries units, conditions and provenance.
Keyboard path and text alternatives are described.
